description: This script reformats PEM files by parsing and annotating ASN.1 structures using OpenSSL, and rewriting the PEM files with added comments.

classes.name: PemBlock
classes.description: A class representing a PEM block with attributes for name, data, and comment.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms PEM file data by parsing and adding ASN.1 structure comments.

methods.name: GenerateCommentForBlock
methods.description: Generates a comment describing the ASN.1 structure of a PEM block using OpenSSL.

methods.name: GetUserComment
methods.description: Removes script-generated comments from a comment string.

methods.name: MakePemBlockString
methods.description: Creates a PEM block string with headers, encoded data, and footers.

methods.name: GetPemFilePaths
methods.description: Returns paths to all PEM files in the script's directory.

methods.name: ReadFileToString
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: WrapTextToLineWidth
methods.description: Wraps text to a specified line width.

methods.name: EncodeDataForPem
methods.description: Base64 encodes data and wraps it for PEM formatting.

methods.name: StripAllWhitespace
methods.description: Removes all whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: IsEntirelyWhiteSpace
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only whitespace.

methods.name: DecodePemBlockData
methods.description: Decodes base64 PEM block data after stripping whitespace.

methods.name: GetPemBlocks
methods.description: Extracts PEM blocks from data using regex matching.

methods.name: WriteStringToFile
methods.description: Writes a string to a specified file.
